repo_detail.description: Defi. Decentralized Finance. This defi protocol web portal for automatic market making in Ethereum based smart contracts via any Ethereum based blockchain. This application provides liquidity schemes via farms, pools and vaults integrated with Metamask wallets.

## Starting the defi project

```
git clone https://github.com/ZetiAi/defi.git
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```

## Building

`pnpm build`

## Preview

You can preview the built app to see how production will perform.

`pnpm preview`
